title: HB 118 (2008 Regular Session): Photo voter identification; require when one appears to vote.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) Each person who shall appear to vote in person at a polling place or the registrar's office shall be required to identify himself or herself to an election manager or the registrar by presenting current state-issued photo identification.
(section) Sec. 1(2)(a)
(quote) Through December 31, 2008, the identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall be limited to the following: (i) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; (ii) A current and valid United States passport;
(section) Sec. 1(2)(b)
(quote) On and after January 1, 2009, the identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall be limited to the following: (i) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; or (ii) A voter registration card with the elector's photograph and that lists the identification cardholder number required under the provisions of law regulating the Statewide Centralized Voter System.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 5(3) (23-15-631)
(quote) The Secretary of State shall prepare instructions on how absentee voters may comply with the identification requirements of Section 1 of House Bill No. ____, 2008 Regular Session.
(section) Sec. 9(1) (23-15-719)
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of House Bill No. ____, 2008 Regular Session,
(section) Sec. 6(3) (23-15-639)
(quote) The election managers shall also take such action as may be prescribed by the Secretary of State to ensure compliance with the identification requirements of Section 1 of House Bill No. ____, 2008 Regular Session.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 3(2) (23-15-169.1)
(quote) Such card shall be distributed to all qualified electors by January 1, 2009, at no cost to such electors.
(section) Sec. 3(1) (23-15-169.1)
(quote) for the purpose of matching information in the database of the Statewide Centralized Voter System created in Section 23-15-163 et seq. to the extent required to enable the Secretary of State to verify the accuracy of information provided on applications for voter registration in compliance with the Help America Vote Act of 2002.
(other) Sec. 1(3): intimidation of a voter under the section is a felony
(other) Sec. 2: 23-15-33 photo registration card by Jan 1 2009
(other) Sec. 4: 23-15-163 brought forward unchanged
(other) Sec. 7-8: 23-15-11 and 23-15-541 conformed to Sec. 1
(other) Sec. 10-11: preclearance and effective date
